# Calculator fixture

Minimal calculator project for mock manifest data and view tests.

**Layout:** `main.py` (entry), `cli/parser.py`, `engine/calculator.py`, `output/formatter.py`. No `calc` package.

**Run:** From this directory, `python -m main` or `./run.sh`. Uses `cli.parser`, `engine.calculator`, `output.formatter`.

**Tests:** `tests/check_operations.py` (engine.calculator add/sub), `tests/check_format_result.py` (output.formatter). Not in main suite. Run from repo root: `PYTHONPATH=tests/fixtures/calculator python -m pytest tests/fixtures/calculator/tests/check_operations.py tests/fixtures/calculator/tests/check_format_result.py -v`.

**Blueprints:** Generated by `PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/create_mock_project_data.py` (default writes to `tmp/calculator/.manifest`; script uses this fixture as project root for extraction). Design has add, sub, mul (mul planned); code has add, sub only.
